stated_problem.quote: You might say in your business, we clean homes better than others. How can you prove that?
stated_problem.speaker: Codie Sanchez

idea.name: Residential cleaning company
idea.one_liner: A cleaning company sells home cleaning and can use specific customer proof to support claims about its service.

key_quotes.quote: A good one would have a photo and a name, and maybe a screenshot so it looks like a text.
A great one would have a photo, a name, a screenshot, maybe a photo of before and after, or the Holy Grail, which would be a video of them actually talking about it.

claims.claim: The speaker says a cleaning company may be able to sell its service at a premium if it can prove its claims.
claims.quote: So really, what we want is for you to have a way to sell it a premium. You need to show that that's a claim you can prove.

ideas.delivery: Cleaning staff clean customers' homes; the transcript discusses using testimonials, before-and-after photos, and payment evidence as proof.
ideas.other_uk_rules: UK consumer contract and consumer rights obligations may apply to residential cleaning services; UK GDPR may apply to customer data and testimonials.
